source_manifest.scope: incomplete initial calibration slice; no runtime or data execution

findings.finding: Cell scorer replaces raw semantics with normalized validation return mapping; production PDM/NRM metric expects raw keys and raises KeyError.
Migration revokes Migrator SELECT/UPDATE privileges needed by SECURITY DEFINER registration triggers owned by Migrator.
Task/cell/summary inserts do not seal or serialize under job lock against freeze; extra task and summary can later bind a registry task absent from frozen digest.
Exact already committed freeze/cell retry attempts INSERT before comparing stored receipt, so BEFORE INSERT deadline check rejects idempotent recovery.
Cell preflight omits installed dataset/split/session/family/window/sampling/FitContext fields, permitting changed context work and a durable cell rejected only in reduction.

required_evidence: Role-separated PostgreSQL migration and ordinary/measured registration
Real SQL sealing/concurrency and post-deadline exact replay
Cell path tests exercising both production PDM and NRM metrics
